segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: The dealer's eyebrows rise as the visitor turns from the table toward the far door. The fresco-side player half-stands, and the dealer stops him with two fingers lifted from his cards.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Ten gold, he asks, for what? For the privilege of leaving with all your blood, little long-ears, but go, go, the passage is short and the dark is long. We will still be here when you come back, and the price will not have fallen. Will it be soon, I wonder?

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.reacts_to: Will it be soon, I wonder?
